packageRules.description: A release is a week old before it is proposed (as a rule, because the preset sets npm's age with one).
Docker Hub dates a tag by its last push and a digest not at all, so an age would hold images forever.
A Node major moves as one: the Dockerfile's image, the workflows' node-version, and its types.
Everything short of a major is one weekly PR that merges itself once verify and image pass: one lockfile change, one deploy.
A 0.x minor is a major by another name: its own PR, for a person.
